name: Candy Kart
about: A toy kart racer's HUD in the candy track's own family: fat berry plates with a cream rim on a plinth, white rounded figures, lemon for what matters (your place, the final lap) and sky for the best. Sized for a glance at speed. A show of stages: chevrons behind the title, confetti behind a menu, streaks while it loads, confetti on a podium, nothing over the lights.
author: mojulo
